fact: The first official cricket Test match was played in 1877 between Australia and England at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. Australia won by 45 runs.
The Thomas Cup, established in 1948, is the premier international men's team badminton championship. India won its first-ever Thomas Cup title in 2022 by defeating Indonesia.
The FIFA World Cup was first held in 1930. Uruguay hosted and won the tournament, defeating Argentina 4-2 in the final match in Montevideo.
Rafael Nadal has won the French Open a record 14 times, making him the most successful male player in the tournament's history.
The NBA was founded in 1946 as the Basketball Association of America before merging with the National Basketball League in 1949.
